status_at_freeze: Before any new validation fit; six exact prior fold-0 fits deliberately reused
purpose: Exploratory post-selection Train-only paired recipe and clipping validation

fixed.scheduler: linear decay with optional linear warmup
fixed.loss: fit-only inverse-class weighted article A/B/C cross entropy
fixed.context: complete articles, at most 4096 article/4608 prompt tokens, reject overflow
fixed.checkpoint: final epoch only, no early stopping or development checkpoint selection

primary: Pool all three held-out folds per seed and recipe, then mean(DE macro-F1, EN macro-F1); average three fixed seeds

comparisons.recipe: candidate minus baseline: joint recipe effect; both have clipping=1
comparisons.clipping: candidate minus candidate_no_clip: identical LR, decay, warmup, seed, fit/dev membership; only clipping differs

analysis.unit: semantic group, paired across all arms and seeds
analysis.sensitivity: Recompute pooled scores excluding selection fold 0; folds 1+2 only
analysis.recipe_gate: Mean primary gain >=1pp, no negative seed primary delta, no mean language loss >1pp
analysis.clipping_support: Mean primary clipping delta>0, each seed primary clipping delta>0, conditional group-bootstrap lower primary bound>0

limits: Recipe selected on fold 0; post-selection CV is not independent Test evidence.
Shared Train articles and three seeds do not constitute independent samples; bootstrap does not account for selection or all training uncertainty.
Six reused fits are linked to original runs, not counted as new training.
Validation measures recipes fitted on 159/160/161 rows, not the saved 240-row artifact directly.
No final-Test inference, no tuning after seeing validation, no automatic serving promotion.
